blocks.text: Cellular respiration woh aalmi (universal) amal hai jis se jandar carbon wale pecheeda compounds (maslan glucose) ko tor kar kaam aane wali tawanai hasil karte hain. Cellular respiration ko mukhtasar taur par yun likhte hain:

Aap dekh sakte hain ke glucose ke atoms ki tarteeb mein zyada tawanai jama hai, jabke CO₂ aur H₂O ke atoms ki tarteeb mein bohat kam. Wajah yeh hai ke glucose mein bohat se C-H bonds hain, jabke CO₂ aur H₂O mein aisa koi bond nahin.

blocks.title: External aur cellular respiration
blocks.text: Jandar aur us ke mahol ke darmiyan CO₂ aur O₂ ka tabadla external respiration (bahari tanaffus) ya saans lena kehlata hai. Cellular respiration woh amal hai jis mein cells ke andar khuraak qadam ba qadam oxidise ho kar cells ko tawanai deti hai.

Tamam cells mein cellular respiration ke bunyadi waqiat taqreeban ek jaise hain. Taqreeban tamam jandaron ke tamam cells glucose ko tawanai ke zariye ke taur par istemal karte hain; isi liye glucose ko respiratory fuel (saans ka eendhan) kehte hain. Cellular respiration ki do bari qismein hain:

items: Anaerobic respiration (fermentation) oxygen ke baghair hoti hai.
Aerobic respiration oxygen ki maujoodgi mein hoti hai.

blocks.title: Sab mein ek jaise reactions
blocks.text: Aap ke cells mein hone wale bohat se reactions mendak (frog), choohe (mice), planaria, khumbi (mushrooms) aur mooli (radishes) ke cells mein bhi hote hain.

Dono qismon ke pehle qadam mein glucose toot kar pyruvic acid (C₃H₄O₃) ke do molecules banata hai; is amal ko glycolysis kehte hain. Is ke baad pyruvic acid ke reactions anaerobic aur aerobic respiration mein alag alag hote hain.
Anaerobic respiration ka tareeqa

Anaerobic respiration bohat se microorganisms aur aala (higher) podon ke kuch cells mein hoti hai; yeh vertebrates ke muscle cells mein bhi hoti hai. Is mein glucose poori tarah oxidise nahin hota, is liye glucose se kam tawanai milti hai: ek glucose molecule se sirf do ATP milte hain (glucose ki tawanai ka sirf taqreeban 2%). Do ATP ki tawanai 14.6 kcal ke barabar hai.
Anaerobic respiration mein pehle glycolysis hoti hai, phir NADH pyruvic acid ko reduce kar ke ya to lactic acid banata hai ya alcohol aur CO₂. Is liye is ki do qismein hain:

a- Alcoholic fermentation: qadeem prokaryotic cells (bacteria) aur kuch eukaryotic cells, jaise yeast (khameer), mein pyruvic acid alcoholic fermentation se mazeed toot kar alcohol (C₂H₅OH) aur CO₂ banata hai:
b- Lactic acid fermentation: is mein oxygen ke baghair har pyruvic acid molecule lactic acid (C₃H₆O₃) mein badal jata hai; CO₂ nahin nikalti:

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein dono equations ki jagah badal gayi hai: alcoholic fermentation ke neeche lactic acid wali equation (2(C₃H₄O₃) → 2(C₃H₆O₃)) chhapi hai aur us ke product ko “Ethyl alcohol” likha hai, jabke lactic acid fermentation ke neeche alcohol aur CO₂ wali equation chhapi hai. Kitab lactic acid ka formula bhi C₂H₆O₃ likhti hai; sahi C₃H₆O₃ hai. Upar dono equations sahi jagah aur sahi shakal mein hain (4H do NADH se aate hain).

Anaerobic respiration ki yeh qisam insanon aur doosre janwaron ke muscle cells mein hoti hai, khaas taur par sakht jismani mehnat ke dauran, jab cells tak oxygen utni tezi se nahin pohanch pati jitni zaroorat hai. Bohat se bacteria bhi tawanai ke liye lactic acid fermentation karte hain.

blocks.alt: Do qataren. Upar: glucose (chhe carbon moti) Glycolysis se guzarta hai, 2 ADP + 2 Pi se 2 ATP aur 2 NAD+ se 2 NADH bante hain, aur 2 pyruvic acid bante hain; Alcoholic Fermentation mein 2 NADH + 2 H+ se 2 NAD+ bante hain aur 2 CO2 nikalti hai, aur 2 ethanol (do carbon wale) bante hain. Neeche: wohi glycolysis, phir Lactic acid Fermentation mein 2 NADH + 2 H+ se 2 NAD+ bante hain, aur 2 lactic acid (teen carbon wale) bante hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.13: Alcoholic fermentation aur lactic acid fermentation (kitab ki Figure 5.13 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Dono raston mein glycolysis se sirf 2 ATP milte hain. Fermentation ka asal kaam NADH ko wapas NAD⁺ banana hai taa ke glycolysis chalta rahe. Yeast mein CO₂ nikalti hai aur ethanol banta hai; muscle mein CO₂ nahin nikalti aur lactic acid banta hai.
Aerobic respiration ka tareeqa

Glucose molecule ka mukammal tootna sirf aerobic respiration mein hota hai. Is mein glucose pehle pyruvic acid banta hai, phir pyruvic acid poori tarah oxidise ho kar CO₂ aur pani ban jata hai, aur C-H bonds mein jama saari tawanai nikal aati hai.

blocks.title: Jab oxygen kam thi
blocks.text: Jab zameen par zindagi paida hui to azaad oxygen dastiyab nahin thi, is liye sirf anaerobic respiration mumkin thi. Photosynthesis ke irtiqa (evolution) se hawa mein molecular oxygen aahista jama hui, aur azaad oxygen ki maujoodgi ne aerobic respiration ka irtiqa mumkin banaya.
Cellular respiration ek musalsal (continuous) amal hai, lekin parhne ki asaani ke liye ise chaar bare marahil (stages) mein baanta jata hai:

items: Glycolysis
Pyruvic acid oxidation
Krebs cycle ya citric acid cycle
Electron transport chain aur chemiosmosis

blocks.text: Glycolysis cytosol (cytoplasm ka maya) mein hoti hai aur is ke liye oxygen zaroori nahin. Baqi teen marahil mitochondria ke andar hote hain jahan oxygen zaroori hai (Fig 5.14).

blocks.alt: Upar do pattiyan Aerobic Respiration (poora raasta) aur Anaerobic Respiration (cytosol wala hissa) dikhati hain. Cytosol mein glucose glycolysis se pyruvic acid banta hai aur 2 ATP milte hain; pyruvic acid alcoholic ya lactic acid fermentation mein ja sakta hai. Mitochondrion mein pyruvic acid acetyl CoA banta hai (CO2 nikalti hai), jo Krebs cycle mein jata hai (do dafa CO2, 2 ATP); phir electron transport chain O2 leti hai, H2O chhorti hai aur 32 ATP banati hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.14: Cellular respiration ka khulasa (kitab ki Figure 5.14 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Upar do pattiyan Aerobic Respiration (poora raasta) aur Anaerobic Respiration (cytosol wala hissa) dikhati hain. Cytosol mein glucose glycolysis se pyruvic acid banta hai aur 2 ATP milte hain; pyruvic acid alcoholic ya lactic acid fermentation mein ja sakta hai. Mitochondrion mein pyruvic acid acetyl CoA banta hai (CO2 nikalti hai), jo Krebs cycle mein jata hai (do dafa CO2, 2 ATP); phir electron transport chain O2 leti hai, H2O chhorti hai aur 32 ATP banati hai. Labels: (Cytosol), (Mitochondrion).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Oxygen na ho to raasta pyruvic acid par ruk kar fermentation ki taraf mur jata hai (anaerobic). Oxygen ho to pyruvic acid mitochondrion mein ja kar poori tarah CO₂ aur H₂O ban jata hai (aerobic). ATP ka hisaab: glycolysis 2, Krebs cycle 2, electron transport chain 32; sab se zyada ATP aakhri marhale se aata hai.
Stage 1: glycolysis

Glycolysis glucose ka pyruvic acid ke do molecules mein tootna hai. Glycolysis dono qism ki respiration (anaerobic aur aerobic) mein hoti hai. Glucose kai qadmon mein toot-ta hai aur har qadam ek khaas enzyme karwata hai (Fig 5.15). Yeh tamam enzymes cytosol mein ghule hote hain. Enzymes ke ilawa ATP aur coenzyme NAD⁺ (nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide) bhi zaroori hain. Glycolysis ke reactions yeh hain:
Preparatory phase (tayyari ka marhala)
Is marhale mein tawanai kharch hoti hai aur glucose toot-ta hai. Is ke qadam yeh hain:

items: ATP se ek phosphate group glucose ko milta hai aur glucose, glucose 6-phosphate ban jata hai.
Glucose 6-phosphate apne isomer fructose 6-phosphate mein badal jata hai.
Ek aur ATP doosra phosphate group fructose 6-phosphate ko deta hai, aur yeh fructose 1,6-biphosphate ban jata hai.

Fructose 1,6-biphosphate bohat reactive hai aur do teen-carbon molecules mein toot jata hai: glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate (G3P) aur dihydroxy acetone phosphate (DAP). Yeh dono ek doosre mein badal sakte hain, aur aakhir mein G3P ke do molecules ban jate hain.

blocks.text: Oxidative phase
Is marhale mein G3P se hydrogen nikali jati hai aur nikalne wali tawanai ATP ki shakal mein jama ki jati hai. Is ke qadam yeh hain (har qadam do dafa hota hai, kyun ke G3P do hain):

blocks.alt: Nau number wale qadam, carbon-moti zanjeeron ke saath. Preparatory phase: glucose (1) se glucose 6-phosphate (qadam 1, ATP se ADP), phir fructose 6-phosphate (2), phir fructose 1,6-biphosphate (3, ATP se ADP), jo (4) glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate aur dihydroxyacetone phosphate mein toot-ta hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.15: Glycolysis ke qadam (kitab ki Figure 5.15 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Nau number wale qadam, carbon-moti zanjeeron ke saath. Preparatory phase: glucose (1) se glucose 6-phosphate (qadam 1, ATP se ADP), phir fructose 6-phosphate (2), phir fructose 1,6-biphosphate (3, ATP se ADP), jo (4) glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate aur dihydroxyacetone phosphate mein toot-ta hai. Oxidative phase, har ek do dafa: glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate (2) se 1,3-biphosphoglyceric acid (5, 2 P andar, 2NAD+ se 2NADH + 2H+), phir 3-phosphoglyceric acid (6, 2 ADP se 2 ATP), phir 2-phosphoglyceric acid (7), phir phosphoenol pyruvic acid (8, H2O bahar), phir pyruvic acid (9, 2 ADP se 2 ATP).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Pehle hisse (gulabi) mein cell 2 ATP kharch kar ke glucose ko do teen-carbon tukron mein torta hai. Doosre hisse (neela) mein har qadam do dafa hota hai: 2 NADH aur 4 ATP bante hain. Hisaab: 4 ATP bane, 2 kharch hue, yani khalis 2 ATP aur 2 NADH.

items: Har G3P oxidise ho kar apni tezabi (acidic) shakal banta hai: G3P se do hydrogen atoms (do high-energy electrons ke saath) nikal kar NAD⁺ ko milte hain, aur saath hi G3P mein ek inorganic phosphate group jur jata hai. Is se 1,3-biphosphoglyceric acid (1,3-BPGA) banta hai.
1,3-BPGA ka phosphate group ADP ko milta hai; 1,3-BPGA, 3-phosphoglyceric acid (3-PGA) ban jata hai aur ek ATP banta hai.
3-PGA, 2-phosphoglyceric acid (2-PGA) mein badal jata hai.
2-PGA se pani nikalta hai (dehydration) aur phosphoenol pyruvic acid (PEP) banta hai.
PEP apna high-energy phosphate ek aur ADP ko de kar ATP banata hai, aur khud pyruvic acid ban jata hai.

blocks.text: Stage 2: pyruvic acid oxidation
Pyruvic acid seedha Krebs cycle mein hissa nahin leta. Krebs cycle mein jane se pehle us mein yeh tabdeeliyan hoti hain:

blocks.title: Glucose cell mein kaise aata hai
blocks.text: Glucose tissue fluid se cells mein passive transport (baghair tawanai ke) ek khaas glucose carrier ke zariye dakhil hota hai. Is carrier ko insulin jaise hormones control (gate) kar sakte hain.

blocks.title: Gluconeogenesis
blocks.text: Glycolysis ko ulta chala kar pyruvic acid se dobara glucose bhi banaya ja sakta hai; ise gluconeogenesis kehte hain.

items: Pyruvic acid se carbon dioxide ka ek molecule nikalta hai aur woh acetaldehyde ban jata hai.
Acetaldehyde oxidise ho kar (hydrogen nikal kar) acetyl group banta hai, aur NAD⁺ ka ek molecule reduce ho kar NADH banta hai.
Acetyl group coenzyme-A (CoA) se jur kar acetyl-CoA banata hai (Fig 5.16).

blocks.alt: Teen number wale qadamon mein structural formulas. Pyruvic acid, H3C-CO-COOH, (qadam 1) mein CO2 kho kar acetaldehyde, H3C-CHO, banta hai. Qadam 2: NAD+ NADH + H+ banta hai aur acetaldehyde acetyl group, H3C-CO-, ban jata hai. Qadam 3: CoA us se jur kar acetyl CoA, H3C-CO-CoA, banata hai. Nikalne ya jurne wale atoms neele rang mein hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.16: Pyruvic acid ka oxidation (kitab ki Figure 5.16 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Teen-carbon pyruvic acid pehle ek carbon CO₂ ki shakal mein chhorta hai, phir hydrogen NAD⁺ ko de kar oxidise hota hai, aur aakhir mein CoA se jur kar acetyl CoA banta hai jo Krebs cycle mein dakhil hota hai. Har glucose se do pyruvic acid bante hain, is liye yeh sab do dafa hota hai.
Stage 3: Krebs cycle

Ab acetyl-CoA reactions ke ek chakkar (cycle) mein dakhil hota hai jis mein oxidation ka amal mukammal hota hai (Fig 5.17). Is cycle ka zyada hissa British biochemist Sir Hans Krebs ne daryaft kiya, is liye ise Krebs cycle kehte hain. Ise citric acid cycle bhi kehte hain, kyun ke is ke pehle qadam mein chhe-carbon wala citric acid banta hai. Citric acid cycle ke tamam qadam mitochondria mein hote hain. Is ke reactions yeh hain:

blocks.title: Oxygen se pehle CO₂
blocks.text: Carbon dioxide oxygen ke istemal se pehle hi nikal aati hai. Is liye yeh kehna sahi nahin ke respiration oxygen ko carbon dioxide banati hai; sahi yeh hai ke respiration glucose ko carbon dioxide aur oxygen ko pani banati hai.

items: Acetyl-CoA, CoA aur acetyl group mein toot-ta hai. Acetyl group chaar-carbon molecule oxaloacetic acid se jur kar chhe-carbon citric acid banata hai.

Citric acid ki oxidative decarboxylation hoti hai: CO₂ ka ek molecule nikalta hai (decarboxylation) aur phir oxidation se ek NAD⁺, NADH banta hai. Is se paanch-carbon molecule alpha-ketoglutaric acid banta hai.
Alpha-ketoglutaric acid ki mazeed oxidation aur decarboxylation hoti hai aur chaar-carbon molecule succinic acid banta hai. Succinic acid CoA se jur kar succinyl CoA banata hai.
Succinic acid aur CoA ka bond high-energy bond hai. Yeh phir toot kar CoA aur succinic acid deta hai, aur nikli tawanai se ATP ka ek molecule banta hai.

Succinic acid oxidise ho kar fumaric acid banta hai. Is ke do hydrogen atoms nikalne se itni tawanai nahin milti ke NAD⁺ reduce ho sake, is liye ek aur electron acceptor, coenzyme flavin adenine dinucleotide (FAD), istemal hota hai aur reduce ho kar FADH₂ banta hai.
Oxaloacetic acid dobara banane ke liye fumaric acid mein pani ka ek molecule jurta hai aur woh malic acid ban jata hai.

Malic acid oxidise ho kar oxaloacetic acid banata hai; malic acid se nikle hydrogen aur electrons ek NAD⁺ ko NADH bana dete hain. Is se cycle mukammal hota hai aur oxaloacetic acid agle acetyl CoA se jurne ke liye tayyar ho jata hai.

blocks.alt: KREBS CYCLE ke gird saat number wale qadamon ka chakkar. Acetyl-CoA (2C) oxaloacetic acid (4C) se jur kar citric acid (6C) banata hai, CoA alag hota hai (1). Citric acid se alpha-ketoglutaric acid (5C), CO2 bahar aur NAD+ se NADH + H+ (2). Alpha-ketoglutaric acid se succinyl-CoA (4C), CO2 bahar, NAD+ se NADH + H+ aur CoA andar (3). Succinyl-CoA se succinic acid (4C), CoA bahar aur ADP + Pi se ATP (4). Succinic acid se fumaric acid (4C), FAD se FADH2 (5).
blocks.caption: Figure 5.17: Krebs cycle (kitab ki Figure 5.17 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: KREBS CYCLE ke gird saat number wale qadamon ka chakkar. Acetyl-CoA (2C) oxaloacetic acid (4C) se jur kar citric acid (6C) banata hai, CoA alag hota hai (1). Citric acid se alpha-ketoglutaric acid (5C), CO2 bahar aur NAD+ se NADH + H+ (2). Alpha-ketoglutaric acid se succinyl-CoA (4C), CO2 bahar, NAD+ se NADH + H+ aur CoA andar (3). Succinyl-CoA se succinic acid (4C), CoA bahar aur ADP + Pi se ATP (4). Succinic acid se fumaric acid (4C), FAD se FADH2 (5). Fumaric acid se malic acid (4C), H2O andar (6). Malic acid se oxaloacetic acid, NAD+ se NADH + H+ (7).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har chakkar mein do carbon (acetyl) andar aate hain aur do carbon CO₂ ban kar qadam 2 aur 3 par nikal jate hain, is liye oxaloacetic acid wapas ban jata hai. Ek chakkar se 3 NADH, 1 FADH₂ aur 1 ATP milte hain; ek glucose se do chakkar chalte hain.
Stage 4: electron transport chain aur chemiosmosis

Electron transport chain mein electrons reduce-shuda coenzymes, yani NADH aur FADH₂, se electron carriers ke silsile ko aur aakhir mein oxygen ko milte hain. Electrons milne ke baad oxygen hydrogen ions se jur kar pani banati hai (Fig. 5.18).

blocks.title: NAD aur FAD
blocks.text: Aap dekh chuke hain ke redox reactions mein substrates se electrons aur hydrogen ions nikal kar coenzymes NAD⁺ aur FAD ko milte hain.

Electron transport chain ke carriers ko electrons milne se oxidation aur reduction reactions hote hain: jo carrier electrons deta hai woh oxidise hota hai aur jo agla carrier leta hai woh reduce hota hai. Ek carrier se doosre tak jate hue electrons tawanai khote hain. Chemiosmosis woh tareeqa hai jis mein membranes in redox reactions ko ATP banne ke saath jorti hain.

Electrons ka rasta: respiration ki electron transport chain mitochondrion ki andar wali membrane (inner membrane) mein bani hoti hai. Chain ke shuru mein NADH oxidise hota hai aur us ke electrons coenzyme Q le leta hai. Agar FADH₂ bhi oxidise ho raha ho to us ke electrons bhi coenzyme Q ko jate hain. Reduce-shuda CoQ electrons cytochrome ‘b’ ko deta hai, jo unhein cytochrome ‘c’ ko deta hai. Cytochrome ‘c’ electrons cytochrome ‘a’ complex (do cytochromes ka majmooa) ko deta hai, aur yeh complex electrons chain ke aakhir mein maujood oxygen atom ko de deta hai.

blocks.alt: NADH se NAD+ aur FADH2 se FAD bante hain jab un ke electrons neeche jati lehredar lakeer (Flow of electrons) mein dakhil hote hain, jo CoQ, Cyt b, Cyt c, Cyt a aur Cyt a3 se guzarti hai. Har carrier par magenta teer reduction aur peela teer oxidation dikhata hai, jaisa legend mein hai. Aakhir mein 2H+ aur aadhi O2 se H2O banta hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.18: Electrons ka raasta (kitab ki Figure 5.18 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har carrier pehle electron le kar reduce hota hai, phir agle ko de kar oxidise hota hai. Electrons neeche, kam tawanai ki taraf, behte hain aur raste mein tawanai chhorte hain. Aakhri qabool karne wali (final acceptor) oxygen hai, jo electrons aur 2H⁺ le kar pani ban jati hai.

ATP ka banna: redox ke dauran electrons se nikli tawanai H⁺ ions ko membrane ki ek taraf (mitochondrion ka matrix) se doosri taraf (inter-membrane space) active transport se bhejne mein lagti hai. Is tarah inter-membrane space mein bohat se H⁺ ions jama ho jate hain. H⁺ ka yeh gradient potential energy jama rakhta hai. Phir H⁺ ions apne concentration gradient ke saath inter-membrane space se wapas matrix mein diffuse karte hain (Fig. 5.19).

blocks.alt: Ek chhota mitochondrion (Inter-membrane space, Matrix) inner membrane ke ek hisse ki taraf ishara karta hai. Membrane mein: electron carriers ke teen protein complex, harkat karne wale carriers Q aur Cyt c, aur ATP synthase. NADH (khuraak se electrons laata hua) NAD+ aur FADH2 FAD banta hai; peela raasta electrons ko complexes se guzarta hai aur aakhir mein matrix mein 2H+ + aadhi O2 se H2O banta hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.19: Mitochondrion mein electron transport chain aur chemiosmosis (kitab ki Figure 5.19 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Ek chhota mitochondrion (Inter-membrane space, Matrix) inner membrane ke ek hisse ki taraf ishara karta hai. Membrane mein: electron carriers ke teen protein complex, harkat karne wale carriers Q aur Cyt c, aur ATP synthase. NADH (khuraak se electrons laata hua) NAD+ aur FADH2 FAD banta hai; peela raasta electrons ko complexes se guzarta hai aur aakhir mein matrix mein 2H+ + aadhi O2 se H2O banta hai. Surkh teer H+ ko teen complexes se inter-membrane space mein pump karte hain; H+ ATP synthase se wapas behte hain aur ADP + Pi se ATP banta hai. Brackets: 1 Electron transport chain, 2 Chemiosmosis.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Teen bare complex electrons ki tawanai se H⁺ ko matrix se inter-membrane space mein dhakelte hain; Q aur Cyt c sirf electrons ek complex se doosre tak le jate hain, H⁺ pump nahin karte. Bahar H⁺ ka hujoom ban jata hai aur woh ATP synthase se wapas matrix mein aate hue ATP banwate hain. Chloroplast mein bhi yahi chemiosmosis hai, bas wahan H⁺ thylakoid lumen mein jama hote hain.

Wapas aate hue H⁺ ions ek khaas protein, ATP synthase, se guzarte hain, aur un ka bahao ATP banwata hai (Fig 5.19). Electron transport chain mein NADH ke ek molecule ke oxidation se teen ATP bante hain, jabke ek FADH₂ se do ATP. Aakhir mein oxygen atom do electrons aur do hydrogen ions le kar pani banata hai.
Substrate-level phosphorylation

Cells phosphorylation, yani ADP mein phosphate group jor kar, ATP banate hain. Is ke do tareeqe hain: chemiosmotic phosphorylation (chemiosmosis) aur substrate-level phosphorylation. Substrate-level phosphorylation chemiosmosis se kahin saada hai; is mein na koi membrane chahiye na electron transport chain. Is mein ek enzyme kisi organic substrate molecule se phosphate group le kar seedha ADP ko de deta hai, aur ek naya organic molecule aur ATP ka ek molecule bante hain. Maslan glycolysis ke aakhri qadam mein ek enzyme phosphoenol pyruvic acid (PEP) se phosphate group ADP ko deta hai; ADP, ATP ban jata hai aur PEP, pyruvic acid. Cell ke kul ATP ka sirf chhota sa hissa is tareeqe se banta hai. Yeh reaction yun dikhaya ja sakta hai:

blocks.alt: Structural khaaka: phosphoenol pyruvic acid jama ADP (ribose-adenine par do phosphate) se pyruvic acid jama ATP. Phosphoenol pyruvic acid ka phosphate group (gulabi) ATP ke teesre phosphate ke taur par dobara gulabi rang mein dikhaya gaya hai.
blocks.caption: Substrate-level phosphorylation: phosphoenol pyruvic acid + ADP se pyruvic acid + ATP (kitab ke is safhe ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Yahan ATP banane ke liye na electron transport chain chahiye na H⁺ ka bahao: ek energy-rich molecule (phosphoenol pyruvic acid) apna phosphate seedha ADP ko de deta hai. Isi ko substrate-level phosphorylation kehte hain; glycolysis aur Krebs cycle mein ATP isi tarah banta hai.
Glucose ke oxidation se hasil tawanai ka khulasa
Glycolysis aur Krebs cycle mein bane NADH aur FADH₂ apne tawanai wale electrons electron transport chain ko dete hain, aur ATP bante hain.

items: Krebs cycle mein bana har NADH chemiosmosis ke zariye teen ATP banwata hai.

blocks.alt: Baen taraf neeche jata bahao: glucose, glycolysis se, pyruvic acid, phir acetyl CoA, phir Krebs cycle. Teer daen taraf hasil batate hain: glycolysis 2 ATP aur 2 NADH jin se 4 ATP; pyruvic acid se acetyl CoA 2 NADH jin se 6 ATP; Krebs cycle 2 ATP, 6 NADH jin se 18 ATP aur 2 FADH2 jin se 4 ATP. Total net yield = 36 ATP.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.20: Glucose ke aerobic oxidation se hasil tawanai ka khulasa (kitab ki Figure 5.20 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Seedhe bane ATP sirf 4 hain (glycolysis 2, Krebs 2); baqi 32 NADH aur FADH₂ ke electrons se electron transport chain mein bante hain. Kitab har NADH se 3 ATP aur har FADH₂ se 2 ATP ginti hai, magar glycolysis wale NADH ko mitochondrion mein le jane par ek ATP kharch hota hai, is liye un se 2-2 ATP. Jama: 2 + 4 + 6 + 2 + 18 + 4 = 36.

items: Glycolysis cytoplasm mein hoti hai, is liye glycolysis mein bane NADH ko mitochondrion ki membrane ke paar le jana parta hai; is par har NADH ka ek ATP kharch hota hai. Is liye glycolysis ka har NADH aakhri hisaab mein teen ki bajaye do ATP deta hai.
Har FADH₂ se do ATP bante hain.

blocks.text: Is tarah glucose ke aerobic oxidation se khalis (net) 36 ATP milte hain, jabke anaerobic respiration ki glycolysis mein sirf 2 ATP bante hain. Yani aerobic oxidation anaerobic se 18 guna zyada kaar-aamad (efficient) hai (Fig 5.20).

blocks.caption: Aerobic respiration mein ek glucose se ATP
rows: Glycolysis ke 2 NADH (transport ki qeemat ke baad 2 har ek)
Pyruvic acid oxidation ke 2 NADH (3 har ek)
Krebs cycle ke 6 NADH (3 har ek)
Krebs cycle ke 2 FADH₂ (2 har ek)

blocks.text: Doosre organic molecules bataur eendhan (fuel)

Hamari khuraak mein azaad glucose molecules aam nahin hote; hum sucrose aur doosre disaccharides, starch, charbi (fats) aur proteins khate hain. Proteins bhi eendhan ban sakte hain, lekin pehle unhein amino acids mein hazam hona parta hai. Aam taur par cell zyada tar amino acids apne proteins banane mein lagata hai. Kuch amino acids ka amino group alag kiya jata hai (de-amination) aur phir woh doosre organic compounds ban jate hain. Yeh compounds aksar pyruvic acid, acetyl CoA ya Krebs cycle ke organic acids mein badal jate hain, aur un ki tawanai ATP mein badal jati hai.

Lipids behtareen cellular eendhan hain kyun ke un mein bohat se carbon-hydrogen bonds hote hain. Pehle yeh glycerol aur fatty acids mein hydrolyse hote hain. Glycerol, glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate (glycolysis ka ek darmiyani molecule) mein badalta hai, jabke fatty acids acetyl CoA ban jate hain. Is tarah fatty acids aur glycerol dono cellular respiration mein dakhil ho jate hain.

blocks.prompt: Daur ke dauran ek daurne wale ke muscles lactic acid fermentation par chale jate hain. Samjhayen ke yeh fi glucose sirf 2 ATP dene ke bawajood kyun faida-mand hai, aur aerobic respiration 36 kyun deti hai.
blocks.explanation: Fermentation pyruvic acid ko NADH se reduce kar ke woh NAD⁺ dobara banati hai jo glycolysis ko chahiye, to jab oxygen muscle tak kafi tezi se na pohanch sake to glycolysis tezi se ATP banati reh sakti hai. Aerobic respiration glucose ko mukammal oxidise karti hai: pyruvic acid oxidation aur Krebs cycle 10 NADH aur 2 FADH₂ bharte hain, aur chemiosmosis ke saath electron transport chain inhen taqreeban 32 mazeed ATP mein badalti hai, oxygen aakhri electron acceptor ke taur par.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: C₆H₁₂O₆ + 6O₂ se 6CO₂ + 6H₂O + tawanai; glucose respiratory fuel hai. Anaerobic respiration (fermentation) 2 ATP deti hai: alcoholic (ethanol + CO₂; bacteria, yeast) ya lactic acid (muscle, bacteria).

Aerobic respiration ke chaar marhale hain. Glycolysis (cytosol, oxygen nahin): tayyari ka marhala 2 ATP kharch kar ke glucose ko 2 G3P mein torta hai; oxidative marhala 2 NADH aur 4 ATP deta hai, 2 pyruvic acid par khatam.

Pyruvic acid oxidation: CO₂ nikalta hai, NAD⁺ reduce hota hai, acetyl group CoA se jurta hai. Krebs cycle (mitochondria; Sir Hans Krebs): citric acid, alpha-ketoglutaric, succinyl-CoA, succinic, fumaric, malic, oxaloacetic; fi chakkar 2 CO₂, 3 NADH, 1 FADH₂, 1 ATP.

Electron transport chain (andaruni membrane): NADH aur FADH₂ se CoQ, cytochromes b, c aur a, oxygen (pani) tak. Chemiosmosis H⁺ ko intermembrane space mein pump karti hai aur ATP synthase ATP banata hai: fi NADH 3, fi FADH₂ 2. Substrate-level phosphorylation substrate (PEP) se phosphate ADP ko deti hai.
Aerobic fi glucose khalis 36 ATP, anaerobic 2 (18 guna). Proteins (amino acids ke taur par) aur lipids (glycerol se G3P, fatty acids se acetyl-CoA) bhi respiration mein dakhil hote hain.
